messages:
maria_cs: urgent escalation from NovaGuide — they rolled with our reranker v2 yesterday and they report a sharp drop in grounding/recall. customer says top citations are gone for ~20-30% of queries, no 5xxs in logs, just worse relevance. tagging @sara_ml and @sam_eng for triage. P1 from customer.

deploy-bot: deployment notice: reranker-service v2.1.0 rolled to prod (us-east) at 2026-03-15T22:10:12Z by ci/cd (rollout-id: rkd-20260315-2210) :rocket:

sam_eng: thanks — can you paste a minimal failing query + the responses before/after the rollout? also which endpoint/params the customer used (top_k, score_norming)?

maria_cs: sharing one example from the ticket (obfuscated):
```
request: {
  "endpoint": "/v1/rerank",
  "model": "redwood-reranker-v2",
  "query": "how to file an amended tax return",
  "candidates": ["doc:123","doc:456","doc:789","doc:321"],
  "top_k": 3
}

before-rollout (v1.9): [doc:456, doc:123, doc:789] -> top doc contains correct citation and paragraph with citation id 3
after-rollout (v2.1.0): [doc:789, doc:321, doc:456] -> top doc misses the paragraph and citation, answer references unrelated policy.
```
customer notes they ran a batch of 1200 queries against a pinned index and measured recall drop ~25% on their labeled set. attached request IDs and PDFs to ticket #NG-4321.

sara_ml: interesting — that change pattern (reordered candidates + missing citation paragraphs) looks like a scoring distribution shift rather than index corruption. could be a change in idf/length normalization or a new embedding quant path. @ops_oncall can you check infra around the rollout window for any kernel/driver or runtime flags differences?

ops_oncall: checked infra diff: no GPU driver upgrades during the deploy; there was a host kernel patch on 2026-03-14 but it was rolled back before the deploy. I do see a tail latency spike at 22:12-22:30Z originating from the reranker pool (p99 from 120ms -> 420ms) and a few memalloc warnings on host gpunode-12. no OOMs.

sam_eng: can we reproduce locally with their candidate set + our v1.9 and v2.1 images? if yes we can bisect the scoring change. maria_cs — can you grant dev team read access to the customer's sample index or dump? or at least share a small reproducible shard?

maria_cs: replied in the ticket with three request_ts and s3 path to the sample shard (shared with redwood-dev-access). customer is willing to run tests if we want them to run a rollback.

sara_ml: i'll run an automated eval on their holdout (1000 queries) against v1.9 and v2.1 tomorrow morning. if the regression reproduces we'll prepare rollback + a hotfix candidate. quick check: did anyone flip `score_norming: enabled` in the new build? that would change ranks.

maria_cs: adding note — customer says they did not change client params. marking this P1; customer on standby for rollback. :pray:
